_说明: D4 离线评测集。category: simple=简单单表查询, agg=聚合统计, join=多表JOIN, time=时间范围, complex=复杂组合。gold_sql 为金标准（均已在 ecommerce.db 验证可执行）。订单类统计口径统一排除 order_status='canceled'。

questions.question: 一共有多少个订单？
一共有多少位客户？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers;

questions.question: 平台上有多少个卖家？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers;

questions.question: 订单评价的平均分是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews;

questions.question: 商品目录里一共有多少种商品？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products;

questions.question: 状态为已发货(shipped)的订单有多少？
已取消(canceled)的订单有多少？
平均每件商品的成交单价是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled';

questions.question: 总 GMV 是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled';

questions.question: 平均客单价是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled';

questions.question: 各支付方式的订单占比是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT payment_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_payments), 2) AS pct
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

questions.question: 订单评价按分数分布是怎样的？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT review_score,
       COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY review_score
ORDER BY review_score;

questions.question: 哪种支付方式的订单量最多？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT payment_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: 客户的复购率是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN buy_times >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct
FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
             COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS buy_times
      FROM customers c
      JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
      WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id);

questions.question: 平均每个订单包含几件商品？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM order_items
      GROUP BY order_id);

questions.question: 信用卡(credit_card)支付的总金额是多少？
所有订单的总运费是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled';

questions.question: 哪个品类销量最高？请列出销量前 10 的品类
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
       SUM(oi.price) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 各州的订单数量分布是怎样的？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

questions.question: 每个州的 GMV 是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY gmv DESC;

questions.question: 取消订单最多的前 5 个州是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS canceled_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY canceled_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.question: 客单价最高的前 5 个州是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.question: 销量最高的前 10 个商品是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       SUM(oi.price) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 销售额最高的前 5 个卖家是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.question: 消费金额最高的前 10 位客户是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_spent
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 2018年1月的订单量是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status != 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018-01';

questions.question: 2017年全年一共有多少订单？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status != 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017';

questions.question: 2018年每个月的订单量趋势如何？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status != 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

questions.question: 2018年每个月的 GMV 是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

questions.question: 平均配送时长是多少天？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date)
              - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

questions.question: 各州在2018年的客单价排名如何？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

questions.question: 在2017和2018两年都买过东西的客户有多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id
      FROM orders o
      JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
        AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2017', '2018')
      GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) = 2);

questions.question: 订单量最高的 3 个月份是哪几个月？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status != 'canceled'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

questions.question: 订单取消率（取消占比）最高的前 5 个州是哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY cancel_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.question: 每个月的新增客户数是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', first_order_time) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_customer_count
FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
             MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_time
      FROM customers c
      JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled'
      GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
